charities.name: Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity
charities.tagline: Help give seriously ill children a brighter tomorrow.
charities.description: Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity helps support seriously ill children across the UK and worldwide. We fund vital medical equipment, groundbreaking pediatric research, and patient-family support services.
charities.mission: To provide transformative healthcare, comfort, and life-changing hope to seriously ill children and their families.
charities.impactStatement: Every ₹5,000 ($60) funds specialized therapy supplies and medical equipment for intensive pediatric care.

events.title: London Golf Links Pro-Am for Kids
events.description: 18-hole Stableford scramble pairing tour professionals and amateurs to fund pediatric surgical tools.

charities.name: Macmillan Cancer Support
charities.description: Macmillan provides physical, emotional, and financial support to individuals and families coping with a cancer diagnosis, helping everyone live life as fully as they can.
charities.mission: Giving people with cancer the specialized medical nursing, guidance, and financial grants they urgently need.
charities.impactStatement: Every ₹2,500 ($30) pays for a registered Macmillan nurse for an hour, helping someone through critical moments.

events.title: Longest Day Golf Challenge
events.description: 72 holes in one day challenge raising funds for Macmillan cancer nurses.

charities.name: Alzheimer's Society
charities.tagline: A kinder future for everyone affected by dementia.
charities.description: Alzheimer's Society is the leading UK dementia charity, transforming the lives of everyone affected by dementia through specialist advisory support and funding research for the cure.
charities.mission: To build a world where dementia no longer devastates lives through direct family support and cutting-edge dementia research.
charities.impactStatement: Every ₹3,000 ($36) funds one hour of specialist telephone dementia advising for families in crisis.

charities.name: British Heart Foundation
charities.description: The British Heart Foundation pioneers research into heart and circulatory conditions, stroke, vascular dementia, and their risk factors to save and improve lives.
charities.mission: Winning the fight against cardiovascular disease through life-saving scientific breakthroughs.
charities.impactStatement: Every ₹5,000 ($60) directly subsidizes cardiac gene discovery research and CPR school training kits.

charities.name: Mind
charities.description: Mind provides advice and support to empower anyone experiencing a mental health problem, campaigning to improve services and promote understanding across all sports communities.
charities.mission: Ensuring nobody has to face a mental health problem alone.
charities.impactStatement: Every ₹2,000 ($24) helps answer two urgent calls on the Mind Infoline for someone seeking hope.

charities.name: Ocean Legacy Marine Restoration
charities.tagline: Restoring coastal coral reefs & removing ocean ghost nets
charities.description: Ocean Legacy partners with coastal golf communities and scientific divers to deploy active artificial reef restoration modules and extract abandoned fishing gear from fragile marine habitats.
charities.mission: To revitalize damaged coastal ecosystems through direct physical intervention, community dive programs, and sustainable marine bio-sanctuaries.
charities.impactStatement: Every ₹2,500 ($30) contributed funds the fabrication and underwater deployment of biological coral nursery substrate.

charities.name: Wildlife Habitat & Forest Rescue
charities.tagline: Emergency rescue, triage, and bushland habitat corridors
charities.description: Providing 24/7 mobile veterinary response units and purchasing critical parcels of wilderness to reconnect fragmented animal migration paths.
charities.mission: Safeguarding native species through emergency veterinary field medicine, sanctuary expansion, and ecological corridor protection.
charities.impactStatement: Every ₹2,500 ($30) pays for full veterinary trauma care and rehabilitation medicine for an injured native animal.

events.title: Bushland Habitat Tree Planting Day
events.description: Planting 2,000 indigenous trees to secure a vital koala habitat bridge.

charities.name: Junior Pathways Golf & Education Trust
charities.tagline: Equipping underprivileged youth with sport mentorship and STEM bursaries
charities.description: Breaking economic barriers by providing golf equipment, PGA coaching, and academic tutoring to students from under-resourced public secondary schools.
charities.mission: Using sport values, discipline, and academic sponsorship to open pathways to university and collegiate scholarships.
charities.impactStatement: Every ₹5,000 ($60) supplies a full semester of junior clubs, range passes, and STEM tutoring for a student.

events.title: NextGen Junior Invitational
events.description: Celebratory stroke-and-stableford showcase honoring scholarship recipients.

charities.name: Frontline Veterans Rehabilitation Fund
charities.tagline: Mental health resilience, adaptive recreation, and transitional careers
charities.description: Supporting military and first-responder veterans coping with PTSD and service injuries through specialized peer-led sports therapy and adaptive athletics.
charities.mission: Empowering returning servicemen and women with community brotherhood, adaptive wellness retreats, and certified career training.
charities.impactStatement: Every ₹2,000 ($24) sponsors a comprehensive clinical peer-support and outdoor mobility session.

events.title: Heroes Cup Adaptive Golf Classic
events.description: Annual team tournament pairing veterans with corporate partners for veteran transition funds.

charities.name: Community Pediatric Heart Care
charities.tagline: Lifesaving cardiac surgeries for children from low-income families
charities.description: Partnering with premier pediatric cardiology hospitals to provide zero-cost open-heart surgeries and diagnostic echocardiograms for vulnerable children.
charities.mission: Ensuring no child is denied curative cardiovascular surgery due to financial distress.
charities.impactStatement: Every ₹10,000 ($120) directly subsidizes cardiac catheterization consumables and ICU recovery costs.

charities.name: Clean Watersheds & Reforestation Alliance
charities.tagline: Restoring native catchment forests to protect regional drinking water
charities.description: Stabilizing riverbanks and restoring native headwater forests surrounding regional dams to eliminate runoff pollution and restore native bird sanctuaries.
charities.mission: Protecting municipal water supplies through organic bioswales and riparian planting.
charities.impactStatement: Every ₹1,000 ($12) buys, protects, and monitors 5 native deep-root riparian shrubs for 3 years.
